effectiveness: Feedback correctness/scope clarification; circuit-design improvement has not been established by a comparison.

rules.text: Design and revise one generic MOS op-amp at25C under the supplied immutable measurement plan. Report success only for executed, qualified cases.

Distinguish current model/unimplemented-adapter limitations from a required case whose current circuit or execution does not establish valid measurement prerequisites. Keep structural limitations unverified and tracked; required unresolved cases still block implemented-scope success. A numeric subcheck without valid prerequisites is diagnostic evidence, not compliance. Do not promise production silicon or full datasheet compliance.
Separate evidence from causal hypotheses. Give concise engineering justifications and predicted tradeoffs; physical causes need targeted probes for confirmation.
Return the complete netlist, preserving the exact frozen GNM/GPM model prefix and .subckt FIRSTAMP P N VP VM OUT interface.

Inside the DUT use only explicit M/R/C elements, four MOS terminals, GNM/GPM, positive finite W/L and capacitance, nonnegative finite resistance, and unique instance names. Use ASCII netlist text and numeric values supported by the validator.
Reference supply pins VM and VP; do not use external node0 inside the DUT. Keep BIAS as an observable bias node for the existing startup contract.

Do not add sources, behavioral devices, nested subcircuits, .include/.param, analysis directives or external files to the DUT. Deterministic external testbenches may use ideal sources and calibration models.
Do not modify model coefficients, targets, fixtures, temperatures, measurement code, test limits or unknown statuses to obtain a pass.

components.title: Conditional design checks, not parameter recipes

rules.text: Check DC bias, headroom, negative-feedback sign and cold startup before interpreting AC or transient failures. Execution errors and missing measurements are different from measured specification failures.
For apparently floating internal nodes, investigate a physical DC path. Evaluate loading, leakage, gain and startup effects before adding or resizing any resistor; there is no universal100Meg remedy.

For output stages check standing current, crossover/shoot-through, source/sink drive and saturation recovery. Bias choices depend on topology and supply; do not force a universal Class-AB implementation.
For multi-stage feedback amplifiers evaluate compensation at actual bias/load and all relevant unity crossings. Do not force canned capacitor/resistor ranges or claim one formula proves stability.

Evaluate self-biased references for startup traps and output saturation for stored-charge/node-excursion delays. Treat each as a hypothesis; avoid copying a task-specific known successful netlist as hidden memory.
The host program owns LTspice execution, testbenches, measurement algorithms, qualification, retry policy and final pass/fail. Supply only a candidate netlist and a structured design justification.
Use each supplied case supply, load, waveform and error band. PDG describes documented dependencies; scheduled delays are explicit project policy, not automatically manufacturer timing facts.
The interface is one channel even when the reference product is dual. Do not invent package-pin mappings or declare channel isolation without a qualified multi-channel coupling test.
Return the required complete JSON response with the exact request_id. Do not return XML, markdown fences, truncated netlists or claimed simulator results.
Use the provided current candidate and first-principles circuit knowledge. Topology changes are allowed within the validator interface, but must retain all test cases and startup observers.
No upstream blueprint values are assumed valid for this frozen model, voltage range or target set. Literature or previous lessons require declared provenance and simulation verification.

Use bias-dependent estimates for gm, headroom, compensation and slew as hypotheses to guide sizing. The external simulator determines measured performance; estimates are not substituted for measurements.

The host enforces frozen models, pin order, legal elements, ground isolation, request binding and immutable case coverage. Invalid responses are rejected with feedback, never silently sanitized into another design.
Keep raw logs, response/netlist hashes, interrupted runs and the best measured candidate. Unavailable token/cost information is null, not zero.

scope_origin: Frozen qualified-adapter registry, not whichever tests happened to run on the initial circuit.
